PUBLIC HEALTH DEPARTMENT
July 28, 1938

The Commissioner of Police.

MR. G. T. S. MALONE

This Department is considering the temporary
engagement of a Mr. George Thomas Silvester Malone
as a Sanitary Overseer; before a definite decision is
reached, I should be much obliged if you would inform
me whether or not there is any Police record of this
man.

（签名）
